system.description:
Candle (Passive): When you hold a candle in one hand, and it is lit, it gives off 5ft of dim light. It burns out after one hour, or with a quick rest.

Illuminate/Extinguish (Action): You light (or extinguish) a source of illumination held in one hand provided you have Flint and Tinder in a combat-readied item slot. All light sources are Quickdraw.

1 Item Slot (Quickdraw) · 1sc · Illumination, rulebook p.200
